defect_location.description: CVE-2021-22945: MQTT 发送时错误地保留已释放内存指针（CVE 描述: erroneously keep a pointer to an already freed memory area and both use that again ... and also free it again）→ UAF + double free。

source.simplification: 剥离 MQTT 传输层与断连状态机，保留『断连释放缓冲后指针未置空，后续发送再次使用并再次释放』核心缺陷

trigger_condition: 向 MQTT 服务器发送数据时服务器断连，断连释放 pending 缓冲后仍被使用
notes: CVE-2021-22945: MQTT 发送时错误地保留已释放内存指针（CVE 描述: erroneously keep a pointer to an already freed memory area and both use that again ... and also free it again）→ UAF + double free。
